package.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。

en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.2
对话窗口按 Codex 的方式重新整理：会话按工作区分组，左侧是固定导航栏，搜索、归档、置顶和分支切换都有了；两种模式改名为「灵伴」与「工坊」，输入栏更简洁。 / The chat window is reorganized the Codex way: chats are grouped by workspace, a fixed rail sits on the left, and search, archive, pinning and branch switching are all here; the two modes are renamed Companion and Workshop, and the composer is simpler.
新功能 / New
- 会话按工作区分组：Nomi 对话按会话的工作区、编程助手按标签目录归到同一个文件夹，每个文件夹默认显示 5 条，点「展开显示」每次再多 5 条；文件夹和「工作区」「最近」分区都可以收起 / Chats are grouped by workspace: Nomi chats by their workspace and coding-agent tabs by their folder; each folder shows 5 chats and "Show more" adds 5 at a time; folders and the Workspaces / Recent sections can be collapsed
- 左侧固定导航栏：对话、任务、素材库，工坊模式下竖排列出全部编程助手，设置在最下面；收起会话面板后，鼠标移到「对话」或编程助手图标上会弹出会话浮层 / A fixed rail on the left: Chats, Tasks and Assets, every coding agent in Workshop mode, and Settings at the bottom; with the chat panel collapsed, hovering Chats or an agent icon pops the chat list out
- 两种模式改名：「Nomi 灵伴」主打聊天、知识问答、记忆与日常事务，「Nomi 工坊」由 Nomi 调度 Claude Code、Codex、多模型完成项目与代码任务 / The modes are renamed: Nomi Companion for chat, knowledge Q&A, memory and everyday tasks, and Nomi Workshop where Nomi orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and multiple models for project and code work
- 搜索窗：放大镜或 Ctrl/⌘+F 打开，搜索对话、本机历史、任务和素材，底部标签切换全部 / 对话 / 任务 / 素材库，素材带缩略图 / A search window (magnifier or Ctrl/⌘+F) finds chats, local history, tasks and assets, with All / Chats / Tasks / Assets tabs at the bottom and thumbnails for assets
- 置顶与归档：置顶的会话在最上面；归档的会话不在侧栏显示，可在「设置 → 通用 → 已归档的对话」里恢复或永久删除；永久删除会再确认一次 / Pin and archive: pinned chats sit at the top; archived chats leave the sidebar and can be restored or deleted permanently in Settings → General → Archived chats; permanent delete asks once more
- 分支切换：新会话输入框上方和右栏「改动」顶部的分支名可以点开，搜索本地分支、切换或新建分支；有会被覆盖的未提交改动时不会切换，改动不会丢 / Branch switching: the branch name above a new chat's composer and at the top of the Changes panel opens a searchable list to switch to or create a branch; a switch that would overwrite uncommitted changes is refused and nothing is lost
- 输入框「+」菜单改成给这条消息加东西：添加图片或文件、引用文件（@）、交给编程助手、知识库问答 / The composer's "+" menu now adds to the message: images or files, a file reference (@), hand-off to a coding agent and knowledge-base Q&A
改进 / Improvements
- 整体布局：导航栏和标题栏在窗口底色上，会话面板与对话区拼成一张圆角卡片；标题栏显示当前会话名和工作区，右上角是会话菜单与改动 · 文件栏开关 / Layout: the rail and title bar sit on the window background and the chat list and chat area form one rounded card; the title bar shows the current chat and its workspace, with the chat menu and the changes · files toggle at the top right
- 会话行更简洁：行首不再画图标，只有工坊「全部」里的编程助手会话在行尾有灰色小图标；悬停显示详情卡片，点卡片里的标题直接改名 / Cleaner rows: no leading icons, only coding-agent chats in Workshop's All view get a small grey icon at the end; hovering shows a detail card where clicking the title renames the chat
- 工作区在新会话的输入框上方选择（可搜索、可不使用），不再放在对话顶栏 / The workspace is picked above a new chat's composer (searchable, can be cleared) instead of in the chat header
- 输入框随内容长高，内容列收窄到 768；「+」、权限、模型和语音按钮去掉边框，模型挪到右侧挨着发送 / The composer grows with its content and the content column narrows to 768; "+", permission, model and voice controls lose their borders and the model moves right next to send
- 麦克风和免按键按钮只在语音识别配好后显示；没配好时「+」菜单里有「设置语音输入…」 / The mic and hands-free buttons only show once speech recognition is set up; until then "+" offers "Set up voice input…"
- 任务与素材库整页放进白色卡片，看板改成浅灰泳道，回对话用导航栏或 Esc / The Tasks and Asset library pages sit in the white card, the board uses light-grey lanes, and you get back to chat from the rail or with Esc
- 滚动条不再常驻，鼠标移到可滚动区域上才出现 / Scrollbars only appear while you hover the area that scrolls
修复 / Fixes
- 新建对话时如果这个工作区已有还没说话的空对话，直接切过去，不再堆一个新的空对话 / Creating a chat reuses the workspace's existing empty chat instead of piling up another one
- 「+」菜单里点选项不再清空正在输入的草稿 / Picking an item from the "+" menu no longer clears the draft you were typing
